title: 第4章 白炎宗长老
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶家大长老一步跨出，向炎崧恭恭敬敬的说道：

“炎崧长老，你是不是误会什么了，我们叶家并没有带任何外人进入。”

他们这些长老岂敢对炎崧说假话，他们是一个极其惜命的人。

他们都不知道有什么人带外人进入了白炎界之中。

“哦。”

炎崧气息散开，令得白炎宗的众人倒吸一口凉气，无尽的冰寒在他们周身笼罩。

炎崧声音很小的说道：“看来你们是不会承认了。”

“唰唰唰。”

一道道声音响起，一位位人进入到叶家主厅之中，

他们的进入，整个叶家主厅都一片死寂。

叶青看向大长老，从口中发出一道命令之声：

“现在，我命令你，前往去调查这件事情，一刻钟出结果。”

叶家已经临近于生死存亡之际。

叶青唯有死马当活马医，让大长老前往调查一下究竟是谁带着外人进入到叶家之中。

他们叶家不能遭受到如此的不白之冤。

“不必了，你们去调查，简直就是在浪费我的时间。”

炎崧手掌轻轻的挥出，那些人将叶家众位长老死死围住。

叶家长老缓缓的聚拢，他们是有苦说不出啊。

带外人进入叶家这件事情，他们不知道。

正是因为这件事情的存在，他们叶家马上就要覆灭了。

“炎崧长老，等等。”

一道急切的声音响起，叶白来到了主厅之中，他向着炎崧恭恭敬敬的一礼：

“炎崧长老，是弟弟叶浩林将那两位外人带了进来。”

叶青：……

他直接懵了，他与叶白等人说过不要见死不救的事情。

现在看来…，叶家不能保全了。

炎崧目光看向一位为首的男子，那位为首男子在看到他的目光后，身躯微微的后退了一下。

他从口中发出了一道颇为清淡的声音：

“人既然已经找到，将叶浩林和那两位带来。”

他目光看向两位男子，不需要多说出哪怕一句话，那两位男子就秒懂其意思。

两位男子离开，半刻钟后，他们将叶浩林带入了叶家主厅之中。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The eldest elder of the Ye family stepped forward and said respectfully to Yan Song:

"Elder Yansong, have you misunderstood something? Our Ye family did not bring any outsiders in."

How dare these elders tell lies to Yan Song? They are people who cherish their lives extremely.

None of them knew that someone had brought outsiders into the White Flame Realm.

"Oh."

Yan Song's aura dispersed, causing everyone in the Bai Yan Sect to take a breath of cold air, and endless coldness enveloped them.

Yan Song said in a low voice: "It seems you won't admit it."

"Swish, swish, swish."

Voices sounded one after another, and people entered the main hall of the Ye family one by one.

As they entered, the entire main hall of the Ye family fell into dead silence.

Ye Qing looked at the great elder and issued a command from his mouth:

"Now, I order you to go and investigate this matter, and the results will be available within a quarter of an hour."

The Ye family is approaching the point of life and death.

Ye Qing had no choice but to serve as a doctor and asked the elder to investigate who brought outsiders into the Ye family.

The Ye family cannot suffer such unfair injustice.

"No need, you are just wasting my time by going to investigate."

Yan Song gently waved his hand, and those people surrounded the elders of the Ye family.

The elders of the Ye family slowly gathered together, they couldn't express their sorrows.

They didn't know about bringing outsiders into the Ye family.

It is precisely because of the existence of this matter that their Ye family is about to be destroyed.

"Elder Yansong, wait."

An urgent voice sounded, and Ye Bai came to the main hall. He bowed respectfully to Yan Song:

"Elder Yansong, it was my younger brother Ye Haolin who brought those two outsiders in."

Ye Qing:......

He was immediately stunned. He had told Ye Bai and others not to ignore death.

Now it seems... the Ye family cannot be saved.

Yan Song looked at the leading man. After seeing his gaze, the leading man stepped back slightly.

He made a rather calm voice from his mouth:

"Now that the person has been found, bring Ye Haolin and those two people."

He looked at the two men, and without saying even a single word, the two men immediately understood what he meant.

The two men left, and half a quarter of an hour later, they brought Ye Haolin into the main hall of the Ye family.
